nodes.label: PRD Template Structure
nodes.rationale: PRD includes Problem Statement, Solution, User Stories, Implementation Decisions, Testing Decisions, Out of Scope, and Further Notes. Does not include file paths or code snippets (they go stale fast) except for prototype snippets encoding decisions more precisely than prose.

nodes.label: Deep Module Extraction During PRD
nodes.rationale: PRD authoring includes actively identifying opportunities to extract deep modules that can be tested in isolation — linking architecture planning to testability requirements.
